purpose: 主安装包携带完整桌面运行链路；市场数据和通达信原始数据独立于主程序，公开补充源按需下载后落盘。

environmentBaseline.uninstaller: legacy optional: 掌财桌面端-运行环境卸载-<version>-x64.exe
environmentBaseline.reuseRule: the verified runtime staging is embedded into the main installer; later program updates reuse it and do not rebuild it

mainProgram.role: Electron shell, Zhangcai program files and the embedded private runtime baseline

programUpdate.role: small subsequent update for code, web assets, skills, bridge and formula seed

requiredEmbeddedRuntime.name: Electron
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.role: Windows 桌面外壳和 Chromium 页面运行时

requiredEmbeddedRuntime.name: Node.js
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.role: 启动网页生产服务和本地桥接脚本
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.installPolicy: private_embedded; reuse same-version install; replace only the copy owned by this desktop install

requiredEmbeddedRuntime.name: Python
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.role: 执行本地行情、通达信公式和数据校验脚本
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.installPolicy: private_embedded; reuse same-version install; replace only the copy owned by this desktop install

requiredEmbeddedRuntime.name: DeepSeek Harness
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.role: 唯一智能体解释和任务编排运行时
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.installPolicy: private_embedded; reuse same-version install; replace only the copy owned by this desktop install

requiredEmbeddedRuntime.name: Zhangcai web scripts and skills
requiredEmbeddedRuntime.role: 本地数据读取、公式桥接、数据门禁和报告落盘

allowedExternalInputs.name: TDX installation or TDX mock data
allowedExternalInputs.role: 只读行情、公式和按需分钟数据
allowedExternalInputs.policy: user-selected-or-user-downloaded; never copied into the main program

allowedExternalInputs.name: Public market, news and research sources
allowedExternalInputs.role: TDX unavailable fallback and scheduled/on-demand supplemental snapshots
allowedExternalInputs.policy: network access only from an explicit update or fallback task; write source/date/retrieval/hash evidence into the user resource library before Harness use

runtimeNetworkPolicy.pythonMarketScripts: TDX/local data first; public quote, news and third-party sources are available only in an explicit update/fallback task and must be persisted into the user resource library
runtimeNetworkPolicy.harness: DeepSeek API access is limited to the bundled Harness process
runtimeNetworkPolicy.installerDownload: the TDX Mock download page is an installer-time user action; runtime public-source downloads are explicit data-update actions and are not embedded in the main program

mainProgramMustExclude: node_modules used only by the build toolchain
Python headers, static libraries, Tcl/Tk development files, tests and bytecode caches

separateDataPack.minuteData: external-on-demand-only; do not copy raw .lc5 into the data pack by default
